about: Revenue of both halves as printed in the HKEX interim filing of Hong Kong board companies (six months to 30.06.2026 and the comparative six months), each read twice independently from the filing itself (link, page, verbatim line). Read by lib/hk-interim.js: the Eastmoney interim pair is used only when both of its halves equal these values within 0.1 %. Lane sd-halbjahr, Daylauf 16. 23.11.2026 (Diener 4e, S1): 129 more companies from the HKEX interim results announcement (reader A) and, where filed, the interim report (reader B); each quote is the revenue line of the income statement on the physical PDF page named, copied from its PyMuPDF text layer (note numbers as in the text layer); documentTitle is the HKEXnews title.
